content: Within six months, sabrina will independently use a fork or spoon for self-feeding in 4 out of 5 meal times, enhancing her adaptive and self-care skills.
Within four months, sabrina will crawl through a tunnel on hands and knees in 4 out of 5 attempts with minimal assistance to improve her gross motor coordination and strength.
Within five months, sabrina will participate in parallel play with peers for at least 5 minutes in 3 out of 5 opportunities, promoting social participation and interaction.
Within four months, sabrina will complete a simple thread lacing activity by threading 3-5 holes with 80% accuracy in 4 out of 5 attempts, improving fine motor control and focus.
Within six months, sabrina will engage in sensory play activities (e.g., sand, water, rice) for at least 10 minutes with minimal prompts, demonstrating increased sensory processing and engagement.
Within five months, sabrina will stand on one foot for at least 3 seconds in 4 out of 5 opportunities with moderate verbal cues, demonstrating improved balance and foundational gross motor skills.
Within six months, sabrina will use a mature pincer grasp to pick up small objects (e.g., beads, coins) from a flat surface in 4 out of 5 attempts, supporting precision in fine motor tasks.
Within five months, sabrina will copy a vertical line and a horizontal line on paper using a crayon in 4 out of 5 opportunities with minimal verbal cues, enhancing pre-writing and tool use skills.
